text_en: The Israelites, the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.
text_cn: 以色列子民全会众于正月来到了亲旷野，人民就在卡德士住下了。米黎盎在那里死了，也就埋葬在那里。

text_en: Now there was no water for the congregation; so they gathered together against Moses and against Aaron.
text_cn: 会众没有水喝，就聚在一起反抗梅瑟和亚郎。

text_en: The people quarreled with Moses and said, “Would that we had died when our kindred died before the Lord !
text_cn: 民众同梅瑟争辩说：“巴不得我们的兄弟在上主面前死去时，我们也死了！

text_en: Why have you brought the assembly of the Lord into this wilderness for us and our livestock to die here?
text_cn: 为什么你们领上主的会众来到这旷野里，叫我们和我们的牲畜都死在这里？

text_en: Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to bring us to this wretched place? It is no place for grain, or figs, or vines, or pomegranates; and there is no water to drink. ”
text_cn: 为什么你们使我们由埃及上来，领我们来到这样坏的地方？这地方不但没有粮食，没有无花果，没有葡萄，没有石榴，而且连喝的水也没有！”

text_en: Then Moses and Aaron went away from the assembly to the entrance of the tent of meeting; they fell on their faces, and the glory of the Lord appeared to them.
text_cn: 梅瑟和亚郎遂离开会众，来到会幕门口，俯伏在地；上主的荣耀遂发显给他们。

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主吩咐梅瑟说：

text_en: Take the staff, and assemble the congregation, you and your brother Aaron, and command the rock before their eyes to yield its water. Thus you shall bring water out of the rock for them; thus you shall provide drink for the congregation and their livestock.
text_cn: “你拿上棍杖，然后你和你的兄弟亚郎召集会众，当着他们眼前对这磐石发命，叫磐石流水。这样你便可使水由磐石中给他们流出，给会众和他们的牲畜喝。”

text_en: So Moses took the staff from before the Lord , as he had commanded him.
text_cn: 梅瑟就照上主吩咐他的，由上主面前拿了棍杖。

text_en: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Listen, you rebels, shall we bring water for you out of this rock? ”
text_cn: 梅瑟和亚郎召集会众来到磐石前，对他们说：“你们这些叛徒，听着！我们岂能从这磐石中给你们引出水来？”

text_en: Then Moses lifted up his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff; water came out abundantly, and the congregation and their livestock drank.
text_cn: 梅瑟遂举起手来，用棍杖打了磐石两次，才有大量的水涌出，会众和他们的牲畜都喝够了。

text_en: But the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you did not trust in me, to show my holiness before the eyes of the Israelites, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land that I have given them. ”
text_cn: 上主却对梅瑟和亚郎说：“因为你们没有相信我，使我在以色列子民眼前被尊为圣，所以你们不得领这会众进入我赐给他们的土地。”

text_en: These are the waters of Meribah, where the people of Israel quarreled with the Lord , and by which he showed his holiness.
text_cn: 这就是默黎巴水的来历，因为以色列子民在那里与上主争辩过，上主因而显示了自己的圣德。

text_en: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, “Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the adversity that has befallen us:
text_cn: 梅瑟由卡德士派遣使者去见厄东王说：“你的兄弟以色列这样说：你知道我们所遭遇的一切困难。

text_en: how our ancestors went down to Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians oppressed us and our ancestors;
text_cn: 我们的祖先下到了埃及。我们在埃及住了很久，埃及人虐待了我们和我们的祖先。

text_en: and when we cried to the Lord , he heard our voice, and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt; and here we are in Kadesh, a town on the edge of your territory.
text_cn: 我们曾向上主呼号，他俯听了我们的呼声，派来了一位使者，领我们出离了埃及。看，我们现在就在你边境上的卡德士城，

text_en: Now let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or vineyard, or drink water from any well; we will go along the King’s Highway, not turning aside to the right hand or to the left until we have passed through your territory. ”
text_cn: 求你让我们由你境内经过；我们决不会踏过庄田或葡萄园，也不喝井里的水，只走王道，不偏右，也不偏左；直至走过你的国境。”

text_en: But Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through, or we will come out with the sword against you. ”
text_cn: 厄东却答复说：“不准你由我这里经过，不然，我要以刀相迎。”

text_en: The Israelites said to him, “We will stay on the highway; and if we drink of your water, we and our livestock, then we will pay for it. It is only a small matter; just let us pass through on foot. ”
text_cn: 以色列子民再对他说：“我们只沿大路走，我们和我们的牲畜若喝了你的水，我们愿付钱；只求步行经过这点小事。”

text_en: But he said, “You shall not pass through. ” And Edom came out against them with a large force, heavily armed.
text_cn: 他仍然说：“不准你经过。”厄东即领大队人马和武装部队出迎。

text_en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through their territory; so Israel turned away from them.
text_cn: 厄东既然不让以色列由他境内经过，以色列就从那里折回。

text_en: They set out from Kadesh, and the Israelites, the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
text_cn: 以色列子民全会众由卡德士起程，来到了曷尔山。

text_en: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor, on the border of the land of Edom,
text_cn: 在厄东国界的曷尔山上，上主对梅瑟和亚郎说：

text_en: “Let Aaron be gathered to his people. For he shall not enter the land that I have given to the Israelites, because you rebelled against my command at the waters of Meribah.
text_cn: “亚郎要归到他祖先那里去；他不能进入我赐给以色列子民的地方，因为你们在默黎巴取水的事上，违背了我的训令。

text_en: Take Aaron and his son Eleazar, and bring them up Mount Hor;
text_cn: 你带亚郎和他的儿子厄肋阿匝尔，一同上曷尔山上去，

text_en: strip Aaron of his vestments, and put them on his son Eleazar. But Aaron shall be gathered to his people, and shall die there. ”
text_cn: 将亚郎的长袍脱下，给他的儿子厄肋阿匝尔穿上，因为亚郎要被召归去，死在那里。”

text_en: Moses did as the Lord had commanded; they went up Mount Hor in the sight of the whole congregation.
text_cn: 梅瑟就照上主吩咐的做了。当着全会众的面，他们上了曷尔山。

text_en: Moses stripped Aaron of his vestments, and put them on his son Eleazar; and Aaron died there on the top of the mountain. Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
text_cn: 梅瑟把亚郎的长袍脱下，给他的儿子厄肋阿匝尔穿上，亚郎就在山顶死了。以后梅瑟和厄肋阿匝尔由山上下来。

text_en: When all the congregation saw that Aaron had died, all the house of Israel mourned for Aaron thirty days.
text_cn: 全会众知道亚郎死了，以色列全家为亚郎举哀三十天。
